g.text: Native-M8 local screens · both candidates slower
M5 Ultra · real Qwen3.8-27B NVFP4 weights · T8/K5,120 · synthetic BF16 inputs
Separate experiment rounds; not paired against each other and not engine Pareto points.
Small marks: all five sequential groups. Large marks: median group ratio. Below 1 favors native M8.
Each group has 20 paired AB/BA samples; 400 raw timings retained per experiment. Focused ratio scale.
E043 parent PASS. E044 parent FAIL (lease −2, unclosed); watchdog + later reconciliation restored service.
Saved numerical outputs match native M8. These warm local results reject adoption; no whole-model speed claim.
